body:
So last night I ground 250 clean Morning Glory seeds, put it in a teabag, and let it seep at the bottom of a glass of distilled water in a dark mini fridge overnight. This morning at 8am, I drank the brown tea.
After 2 hours, I was very relaxed, almost high. I was waiting for the trip to start, so I went outside to a bike trail. I was relaxed, but not a trip because there were no hallucinations whatsoever. Its been 5 hours, and I am completely sober. I dont know what I did wrong, but next time I will try H.B. Woodrose.
